tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (tha)༄༅/ /bla ma don yod grub pa'i mchod chog bilba'i snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgyal kun phrin las margad kyi/ /phung por 'babs pa'i bca
(tha)༄༅/ /bla ma don yod grub pa'i mchod chog bilba'i snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgyal kun phrin las margad kyi/ /phung por 'babs pa'i bca

tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// bla ma don yod grub pa'i mchod chog bilba'i snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgyal kun phrin las margad kyi// phung por 'babs pa'i bcom ldan 'das// dbyer med bla ma la btud nas// mnyes byed mchod pa'i cho ga bri// de la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum/ dang po ni/ rta mchog rigs kyi dbang rjes gnang thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom par gnas shing*/ thar lam bla mar re ba'i gang zag gis gnas gtsang zhing yid dang mthun par stegs mtho bar dar ram ras kyis bkab pa'i steng bskyed chog dang mthun pa'i bris sku'am/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku 'bag gam/ tha na'ang dbu lo phyag sen na bza'i dum bu tsam la dmigs rten byas te/ de'i mdun du stegs bang rim can gyi gong mar zhal zas/ de 'og nas mar rim par dri chab/ mar me/ spos reng*/ me tog yon chab kyi phreng ba rnams re re nas brgya rtsa 'am/ bdun phrag gsum mam lnga sogs gang 'byor dang*/ de'i 'og tu chu gnyis nyer spyod dang*/ gong 'og gang rung du maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bkod pa'ang bsham/ 'byor na bla bre/ yol ba/ 'phan gdugs la sogs pas kyang brgyan la/ maṇ+ḍal grangs gsog gi chas dang*/ gos zung rol mo'i bye brag sogs 'du bya'o// dngos gzhi'i ngag 'don la/ mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/

phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bla ma don yod grub pa'i cho ga nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ mdun gyi dmigs rten la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid bai ḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs kyi khri lhun stug pa/ bkod pa legs pa/ 'od chags pa/ rgya che zhing dpangs mtho ba/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa gdan lnga brtsegs kyi steng du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa sku mdog margad lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon pas mnyam bzhag dang*/ g.yas pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas gdul bya rnams la mi 'jigs pa ster ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ spyi gtsug sems can thams cad kyis lta bar mi mngon pa la sogs pa mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba la sogs pa dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/

'od zer bye ba 'gyed pa/ de'i mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ khyad par du yang byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad pa dang*/ kun tu bzang po la sogs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par gyur/ de thams cad kyang sku mdog ljang gu mdangs dang 'od zer ljang gu dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa'i las mdzad pa'o// de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// khyod ni rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras// rab byung dge bsnyen khyim pa sogs// 'gro ba kun gyi gzugs mdzad nas// gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad// nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang*// me shel med par me mi 'byung*// de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang*// bla ma med par 'byung mi 'gyur// des na khyod nyid mnyes pa yis// sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par 'gyur// dkon mchog gsum po gcig bsdus pa'i// bla ma khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// chos rnams kun gyi rin chen gter// dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dpal ldan bla ma de la 'dud// khyod ni gdul bya smin pa'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa lnga// khyod kyi phung po rnam lngar ston// spyan sogs khyod kyi 'byung ba bzhi// sa yi snying po rdo rje 'chang*// nam mkha'i snying po spyan ras gzigs// 'jam dbyangs sgrib pa rnam par sel// byams pa kun tu bzang po rnams// mgon po khyod kyi dbang po sogs// gshin rje'i gshed sogs khro bo bcu// dpal ldan khyod kyi sku yi cha// gzugs sogs rdo rje lha mor ston// nyon mongs ye shes gnas gyur pa// bdag nyid chen po khyod kyis mkhyen// thams cad spro ba'i phrin las kyis// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad sprul// gcig tu bsdus pa'i sbyor ba ni// sangs rgyas kun bdag rdo rje 'chang*// bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib kun spangs// yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa// khyod kyi phrin las ngo mtshar rmad// gang gis g.yo med khyod bsten pa// de la de ma thag byin rlob// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs 'tshang rgya// yang na phun tshogs thams cad 'grub// des na rdo rje slob dpon mchog

/dngos po kun gyis de la 'dud// rnam pa kun tu bdag skyabs mchi// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na// lus dang longs spyod 'brel ba kun// srog gi bar gyis khyod mnyes bgyi// ji srid rnam par grol ba'i sa// bdag gzhan kun gyis ma thob bar// de srid mchod pa mchog gi sprin// kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las// ches lhag gyur pas khyod mchod do// khyod ni gang la mnyes gyur pa'i// phrin las de nyid sgrub par shog /mi mnyes byed pa rnam spangs te// rnam pa kun tu khyod bsten no// khyod kyi phrin las sgrub slad du// mgon po gang la mnyes gyur na// gal te bla na med pa yi// byang chub thob kyang de dor te// skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub par bgyi// dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// khyed mnyes bgyid pa'ang thob par shog /sku yi spyod pa rnam dag pa// sangs rgyas dges pa'i tshul khrims ldan// gsung gi phrin las phun sum tshogs// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus khyab// thugs kyi dgongs pa rab zab pa// chos rnams kun gyi de nyid mkhyen// mkhas pa thams cad dga' mdzad pa'i// yon tan rgya mtsho khyod la mnga'// sems can thams cad smin mdzad pa'i// phrin las mnga' ba chos kyi rje// khyod la bsu bas dpal du byed// bsten pas blo gros mchog tu gyur// brten na 'jigs pa med par mdzad// bsnyen bkur bgyis pas bde ba 'byung*// de 'dra'i dpal ldan chos kyi rje// bla ma mchog la bdag gsol 'debs// mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni// bla ma mchod pa bya'o zhes// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// de bas dngos po thams cad kyis// bla ma mnyes par byed par shog /skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan// ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar// de srid bla ma'i zhabs drung du// 'bral ba med par gnas gyur cig /mchod pa kun gyis mchod byed cing*// dam chos rtag tu nyan pa dang*// bka' bzhin sgrub pa'ang byed par shog

/ces dang*/ sger phyag ni/ bka' drin sum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las bye ba'i gter// margad mdog ldan bdud rtsi'i phung po yi// rnam par shar la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs smon lam mthar phyin pas// mthong dang thos dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// dngos grub rnam gnyis lag rtser 'grub mdzad pa'i// bcom ldan thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// khro dang rjes su chags pa mi mnga' yang*// khro ba can la khro bo'i rnam pa sogs// bstan nas phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don// gcig car sgrub pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bstod pa'i rigs gang shes kyis phyag 'tshal/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs pa yi// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// thog ma bar dang mthar dge zhing*// rnam par dkar la ma 'dres pa// nges par 'byung ba mchog gi lam// dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams zhing rab mchog gyur pa// lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i gnas// rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra bcom pa// tshogs mchog dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal// tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan zhing*// ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gnas// bde gshegs bstan pa legs 'dzin pa'i// bshes gnyen kun la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgras// bla ma'i tshogs dang dkon mchog mchod// 'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas pa// bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i// mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis pa// blo yis blangs nas dbul bar bgyi// rab dang yid las byung gyur pa'i// mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po ni// mkha' dang mnyam pa du ma yis// yon tan rgya mtsho sras bcas mchod// dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog

/dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba'i// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen po brnyes gyur cig /mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla ma mchod// oṃ gu ru a mo gha sid+dhi ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ sil snyan rnams dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da rnams bcug oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs/ oṃ sarba bit+pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ gu ru a mo gha sid+dhi tsakra rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren cing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ ma ṇi rat+na/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wasti rat+na/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /ma hā ta rat+na/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg par rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti rat+na/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob ste// sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod par shog

/a shwa rat+na/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaṅga rat+na/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru a mo gha sid+dhi rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// gan+dhe/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// tshig tha ma gnyis dang*/ sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra bar/ shab+da/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// ra sa/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// spar+she/ g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i ral gri dang*// tsha grang gnod pa skyob pa'i pags pa dang*// yang 'jam nyon mongs med pa'i mal cha dang*// dga' mgur rtse bar byed pa'i yid 'ong tshal// gang 'dod lta nus bde bar nyal ba'i khyim// thags bzang bsreg bcad mi nus 'jam pa'i gos// chu la mi bying ngal dub med pa'i l+h+wam// nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'di dag gis// zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing gzhan rnams// bkang ste dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// sap+ta u pa rat+na/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/

rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg mo ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ bdug spos ma/ me tog ma/ mar me ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag gi rgyud la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sku gnyis kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// 'dren pa kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can sogs tshig rkang phyi ma gsum re re bzhin sbyar te/ yi dam kun 'dus/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ dam chos kun 'dus/ dge 'dun kun 'dus/ byang sems kun 'dus/ nyan rang kun 'dus/ chos skyong kun 'dus/ nor lha kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// de nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma brgya rtsa re dang*/

so bdun ma gsol gdab bcas spel mar ci nus su phul la/ gang gi mchod rdzas zhing khams rgya mtsho rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung gis// rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyan gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i 'od kyi rtse mor rgya mtsho yi// rdul gyi grangs snyed rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin kun nas rgyas pa'i snying po la// lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rmad 'di 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byung bye ba phrag brgyar legs gnas pa// kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin kun nas dge ba'i sems kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'di// chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i khams kun kun la khyab cing sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid bar// rnam par gnas nas chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal bas// kun nas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu rnam par mchod pa'i mchod pa kun gyis mnyes gyur cig /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams// sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir// gus pas khyed la dbul bar bgyi// kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa'i// yon gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis// bdag la brtse bar nyer dgongs te// bdag gi 'di dag bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ gu ru a mo gha sid+dhi rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ bla ma don yod grub pa'i thugs ka'i āḥyig las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo nas bzhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas par bsams la/ oṃ gu ru a mo gha sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes brgya stong bzla/ 'dod gsol ni/ me tog 'thor nas/

ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i rnam rgyal ma'i bstod pa'i/ bdag gis bcom ldan khyod sku legs bsgom zhing*// sogs dang*/ 'gro la bde skyid ma'i mthar/ bdag ni thog med dus nas su// las dang nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// lus dang ngag dang yid sgo nas// rang bzhin sdig pa ci bgyis dang*// sdom pa gsum dang 'gal gyur pa'i// nyes pa'i tshogs kun rab 'gyod pas// mchod 'os rnams kyi spyan snga ru// slan chad bsdam pa'i sems kyis bshags// bla ma'i phrin las rmad byung dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom so so skye bo yi// dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs// 'gro kun smin cing grol bya'i phyir// bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas la// zab pa dang ni rgya che ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// sems can ji srid gnas kyi bar// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs nas// 'gro ba kun gyi don mdzad par// thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// bla ma mchog dang sangs rgyas dang*// chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// rtag tu gus pas bdag skyabs mchi// sems can kun gyi don slad du// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bya'i phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// byang chub spyod pa'ang spyad par bgyi// ye shes gsal ba'i spyan ldan pa'i// brtse ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa kun// yud tsam bdag la dgongs su gsol// ma rig pa yis ldongs gyur cing*// las kyi chu klung gis 'phangs pas// srid pa'i rgya mtshor lhung gyur te// nyon mongs chu srin dbang gyur pas// mi bzad sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i// nyam chung blo gros rab dman pa// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// skyob pa mdzad par gsol ba 'debs// bdag cag rnams kyis rab 'bad kyang*// thar pa'i go skabs rnyed par dka'// khyed kyis thugs rje'i phyag brkyangs nas// srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol// mngon par 'du byed kun gyi gzhi// tshul min yid la byed pa'i rgyu// ma rig mun pa thibs po che// ye shes zer gyis bsal du gsol// srid pa'i nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// rtog pa thams cad skyed byed pa// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'khri shing ni// shes rab ral gris gcad du gsol// kun rmongs kun 'khrugs kun nas dkris// nga rgyal dang ni phrag dog kun// mgon po khyod kyi mthu chen gyis// ye shes chen por bsgyur du gsol// srid pa thog med dus nas su// sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// bag chags dri ma gang bsags pa// ye shes chu yis sbyang du gsol// rang gis mngon par spyad pa'i mthus// rang la rang dbang med par ni// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor 'phen byed pa'i// las kyi rlung shugs bzlog tu gsol// las dang nyon mongs kyis sprul pa'i// skye rga na dang 'chi la sogs// sdug bsngal 'du byed 'gyur ba yi// sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad du gsol// thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*// theg chen nges par 'byung ba las// sems can rnams ni rab slu ba'i// bdud kyi las rnams bzlog tu gsol// 'jig rten pa yis don gnyer ba'i// rnyed dang bkur sti la sogs pa// snying po med pa'i bya ba las// yid ni rab tu bzlog tu gsol// kun gzhi'i lte ba rab brtan cing*// rten 'brel yan lag rtsibs bcu gnyis// sdug bsngal mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i// srid pa'i 'khor lo gzhig tu gsol// gzhan don la skyo bdag chags pas// rang nyid zhi ba don gnyer ba// nyan thos theg pa dman pa'i sems// rnam pa kun tu dgag tu gsol// bdag gis lus dang ngag dang ni// de bzhin yid kyi sgo nas kyang*// sems can kun la rnam kun tu// phan pa rgya chen 'byung bar mdzod// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la// phyi dang nang gi 'tshe ba yi// bar du gcod pa thams cad kun// nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol// bshes gnyen grogs mchog dam chos dang*// gnas bzang ba dang yo byad sogs// rtag tu mthun pa'i rkyen rnams kun// lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing*// 'gro kun rtag tu 'dun pa dang*// ji ltar bsams pa'i don rnams kun// chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe// bla ma mchog dang he ru ka

/mkha' 'gro'i dbang po dpag yas kyis// mkha' spyod gnas su bkri bar mdzod// mang du smos kyang ci 'tshal te// dbang bcu ldan pa khyed rnams kyis// ji ltar go 'phang mchog brnyes pa// de ltar bdag gis thob par mdzod// bdag gzhan srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis// rnam pa kun tu nyam thag pas// mi shes bzhin du gsol pa la// nyes pa snang gang bzod par gsol// dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// ma lus gcig tu bsdom byas nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bdag ni tshe rabs thams cad du// rigs gzugs 'byor ldan shes rab dang*// dbang phyug phun sum tshogs gyur cing*// nad med tshe dang ldan gyur cig /sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes byed cing*// dam chos rtag tu spyod pa dang*// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rnam pa kun tu mchod par shog /kun dga'i gsung rab rtag nyan cing*// sku yi rgyal mtshan blta ba dang*// de yi dpal 'byor bzang po yis// rtag tu bdag ni skyong bar shog /dad dang brtse dang brtson pa'i mthus// byang chub lam rnams rdzogs byed cing*// sangs rgyas zhing kun sbyong ba dang*// sems can smin par byed par shog /yid bzhin nor bu chen po ltar// bdag las sems can thams cad kyi// yid la 'dod dgu 'byung 'gyur zhing*// 'gro kun tshim par byed par shog /bdag la brten nas 'gro ba kun// zab mo'i lam la rab zhugs nas// srid dang zhi la mi gnas pa'i// byang chub chen po thob gyur cig /blo gros sgrib gnyis rnam dag pas// shin tu zab pa'i blo gros dang*// rgya che'i blo gros dang ldan pa'i// blo gros chen por bdag gyur cig /tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang ldan zhing*// chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs bzung bas// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan brtan byas nas// thar pa'i rgyal mtshan slong bar shog /tshogs gnyis dpal rab rdzogs gyur nas// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon 'byung ba'i gzhi// sku gsum dpal 'byor lhun grub ste// srid zhi'i dpal du bdag gyur cig

/smon lam bzang po las byung ba'i// phrin las bzang pos 'gro ba kun// skal ba bzang por legs bsgrub pa'i// brtul zhugs bzang por bdag gyur cig /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi// rjes su bdag kyang rab bzhugs nas// dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// thams cad yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// gzhan yang skye ba 'di nyid du// mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs// rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi rje/ chos kyi rgyal po/ chos kyi dbang phyug chos dam pa'i 'byor pa thams cad kyis phun sum tshogs shing*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dpal dam par gyur pa bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ gnas skabs kyi rkyen las gyur pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa dang*/ 'byung po'i gnod pa dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang*/ phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang mtshan ma'i rnam par g.yeng ba la sogs pa srid pa 'khor bar 'gyur ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang*/ gzhan gyi don la skyo ba dang*/ rang nyid zhi bar 'dun pa la sogs pa mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba'i rnam par rtog pa gang lags pa thams cad mi 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

bdag gi sems las su rung ba dang*/ bag yod pa dang*/ dran pa dang bshes bzhin yang dag pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnam par dag cing*/ sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ ltung ba dang nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dad pa dang snying rje dang shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis bzung du chud nas/ lung dang mngon par rtogs pas bsdus pa'i chos kyi snang ba dam pa dang rtogs pa dge ba khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gang gi tshe bdag 'chi bar gyur pa de'i tshe tshe 'di dang 'jig rten 'di la mngon par zhen pa dang bral zhing lus dang sems la zung rngu dang sdug bsngal cung zad tsam yang mi 'byung bar dga' ba dang spro ba dang yid gsal ba mchog dang ldan zhing ting nge 'dzin dam pa rgyud la skyes nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs yang dag par mthong zhing*/ de dag gi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas bsus te/ bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ bdud dang gshin rje'i spyod yul thams cad las shin tu 'das nas rig pa 'dzin pa dang mkha' la spyod pa la sogs pa'i go 'phang mchog tu skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skye ba dang srid pa thams cad du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral zhing srid pa dang zhi ba'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thob ste/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs yang dag par bzung nas/ chos kyis phongs pa'i sems can thams cad la chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po gtong zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas nas/ dngos po thams cad kyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par byas te sa dang lam thams cad bde blag tu bgrod nas/

sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma don yod grub pa 'od du zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ bla ma don yod grub pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bya byed dang bcas pa dbyer med du gyur pa'i ngang la ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag go /rjes/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /don yod grub pa 'grub gyur nas// sogs kyi bsngo smon ci shes bya'o// bcom ldan margad mdangs ldan gyi// mchod chog gsal bar bkod pa'i dges// bdag sogs 'gro kun sgrib sbyangs nas// rdo rje 'dzin sar reg gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa'i mchod chog bilba'i snye ma zhes bya ba 'di ni sgrub thabs rin po che kun las btus pa'i zhal skong du blo gter dbang pos bris pa dge/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
